item.description: From cardboard boxes to air conditioners, CNA explains what can be recycled and where. The article is part of Beyond the Bin, a Mediacorp initiative raising awareness on the 3Rs - reduce, reuse and recycle - and more sustainable waste habits in Singapore.

item.title: CNA (Singapore): A little less power, just as much fun? Driving the new Mini Cooper One in Singapore
item.description: The entry-level Mini Cooper One brings together a three-cylinder engine, sharp steering and compact dimensions. We find out what it’s like to drive on Singapore roads.

item.title: CNA (Singapore): Trump sees difficulties ahead if Schumer leads Senate
item.description: “It is going to be very hard for me to work with Chuck Schumer should he become Senate Majority Leader,” US President Donald Trump says.
